title: Extract duplicated validation logic into a shared helper
description: A Python module has the same email-validation regex duplicated in three places. Extract it into a shared validate_email(email: str) -> bool helper in a utils.py module. Behavior must be identical.

task_spec.prompt: This codebase has the same email-validation regex copy-pasted in three places (see src/handlers.py, src/models.py, src/cli.py). Extract it into src/utils.py as validate_email(email: str) -> bool. Update all three callers. Do not change the regex or the public behavior. All tests must still pass.
success_criteria: handlers.py, models.py, cli.py all import from utils
Regex not duplicated anywhere in the codebase
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.

check_commands.lint: uv run ruff check src/ tests/
